components.name: gauge
components.title: Gauge
components.description: Gauge is a vector SVG dial component used to visualize numeric meters, audio level visualizers, percentages, or knob values. Supports complete circular (circle) or semicircular (semicircle) modes with animated transitions, center value text, and sub-labels.

boonkerDemo.description: Interactive demo demonstrating circular gauges, semicircle gauges, custom colors, dynamic value updates, and audio VU meters.

components.name: grid
components.title: Grid / Layout Grid
components.description: Modern CSS Grid layout system in Techno4 Framework 2. components.name: infinite-scroll
components.title: Infinite Scroll
components.description: Infinite Scroll automatically fetches and appends additional content as the user scrolls toward the bottom (or top) of a page-content container. Prevents pagination disruption and integrates cleanly with virtual lists.

boonkerDemo.description: Interactive demo demonstrating dynamic batch appending of list items upon scrolling near page bottom.
